one_liner: Telegram offers a free HTTPS Bot API (bot token from @BotFather) plus the MTProto user API (api_id); easy to build on, though the pages show no vendor MCP server and the draft's community MCP claim isn't verifiable from them.
auth_notes: Bot API: each bot gets a static authentication token used in the URL path (API_KEY). MTProto user API uses phone-based user authorization, 2FA SRP and a registered application id (OTHER). The draft's OAUTH2 entry (Telegram Login OIDC) is not supported by any provided page and is for website sign-in rather than delegated API access, so it was removed.
access_notes: The Telegram docs state both the Bot API and the Telegram API are free to use. Bot tokens are issued on bot creation. The Gateway API is a separate, funded product and is not needed for the core API.
blocker_notes: Bot tokens are per-bot, so each customer needs their own bot. Bot developer ToS restricts data scraping and sharing credentials. MTProto user-account use carries ToS risk.
